```{r}
library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
set.seed(42)

# True response rate (unknown to the analyst)
theta_true <- 0.35

# Data
n <- 30
y <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = theta_true)

# Summarise
cat("n =", n, "\n")
cat("Successes =", sum(y), "\n")
cat("MLE of theta =", mean(y), "\n")

# Package for Stan
data_list <- list(
  n = n,
  y = y,
  prms_alpha = 1,
  prms_beta = 1
)
```



```{r}
library(cmdstanr)

# Compile
model <- cmdstan_model("stan/beta_binom.stan")

# Fit
fit <- model$sample(
  data    = data_list,
  chains  = 4,
  parallel_chains = 4,
  iter_warmup   = 1000,
  iter_sampling = 1000,
  seed    = 42
)

# Check convergence first — always before looking at results
fit$cmdstan_diagnose()

# Posterior summaries
fit$summary(variables = c("theta", "y_rep", "above_threshold"))

# Extract draws for plotting
library(posterior)
library(ggplot2)

draws <- fit$draws("theta", format = "df")

ggplot(draws, aes(x = theta)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 60, fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = mean(y), color = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Posterior distribution of theta",
       subtitle = "Red dashed = MLE",
       x = expression(theta), y = "Density")
```

## Poisson Model

```{r}
set.seed(42)

# True incidence rate (unknown to analyst)
lambda_true <- 0.003  # 3 cases per 1000 person-years

# Exposure
t <- 5000  # person-years at risk

# Observed cases
y <- rpois(1, lambda = lambda_true * t)

cat("Person-years at risk:", t, "\n")
cat("Observed cases:", y, "\n")
cat("MLE of lambda:", y/t, "\n")
cat("MLE per 1000 person-years:", (y/t)*1000, "\n")

data_list <- list(y = y, t = t, prms_alpha = 2, prms_beta = 500)
```


```{r}
model <- cmdstan_model("stan/poisson_gama.stan")
fit <- model$sample(data = data_list,
                    chains = 4, 
                    parallel_chains = 4,
                    iter_warmup = 1000,
                    iter_sampling = 1000,
                    seed = 42)

fit$cmdstan_diagnose()
fit$summary(variables = c("lambda", "rate_per_1000", "y_rep", "above_threshold"))
```


```{r}
draws <- fit$draws("rate_per_1000", format = "df")

ggplot(draws, aes(x = rate_per_1000)) +
  geom_histogram(aes(y = ..density..), bins = 60,
                 fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = (y/t)*1000, color = "red",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3, color = "black",
             linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Posterior: incidence rate per 1000 person-years",
       subtitle = "Red = MLE | Black = true rate (3 per 1000)",
       x = "Rate per 1000 person-years", y = "Density")
```

## Part 2

```{r}
set.seed(42)

lambda_true <- 0.003  # same true rate for all counties

# Counties differ dramatically in population size
counties <- data.frame(
  county = c("A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"),
  t      = c(500, 1000, 2000, 5000, 10000, 20000)  # person-years
)

counties$y         <- rpois(6, lambda = lambda_true * counties$t)
counties$raw_rate  <- (counties$y / counties$t) * 1000  # per 1000 PY
counties$expected  <- lambda_true * counties$t

print(counties)

# Notice: raw rates vary wildly for small counties
# Package for Stan
data_list2 <- list(
  J          = nrow(counties),
  y          = counties$y,
  t          = counties$t,
  prms_alpha = 2,
  prms_beta  = 500
)
```
```{r}
model2 <- cmdstan_model("stan/poisson_gamma_pooled.stan")

fit2 <- model2$sample(
  data = data_list2,
  chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4,
  iter_warmup = 1000, iter_sampling = 1000,
  seed = 42
)

fit2$cmdstan_diagnose()
fit2$summary(variables = c("lambda", "rate_per_1000"))
```




```{r}
# Pooled posterior draws
fit2$draws("rate_per_1000", format = "df") |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_density(aes(x = rate_per_1000), fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  # Raw county rates (points)
  geom_point(data = counties,
             aes(x = raw_rate, y = 0, size = t),
             color = "red", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_text(data = counties,
            aes(x = raw_rate, y = 0.05, label = county), size = 3) +
  # True rate
  geom_vline(xintercept = 3, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "Person-years") +
  labs(title = "Pooled posterior vs. raw county rates",
       subtitle = "Black dashed = true rate (3 per 1000) | Point size = county size",
       x = "Rate per 1000 PY", y = "Density")
```


```{r}
set.seed(42)
n <- 50

# True parameters (unknown to analyst)
alpha_true <- 90    # baseline SBP at age 0 (intercept)
beta_true  <- 0.6   # SBP increases 0.6 mmHg per year
sigma_true <- 10    # residual SD

age <- runif(n, min = 30, max = 80)
sbp <- alpha_true + beta_true * age + rnorm(n, 0, sigma_true)

# Frequentist benchmark
lm_fit <- lm(sbp ~ age)
summary(lm_fit)

data_list <- list(N = n, age = age, sbp = sbp)
```

```{r}
model <- cmdstan_model("stan/normal_regression.stan")

fit <- model$sample(
  data = data_list,
  chains = 4, parallel_chains = 4,
  iter_warmup = 1000, iter_sampling = 1000,
  seed = 42
)

fit$cmdstan_diagnose()
fit$summary(variables = c("prms_alpha", "prms_beta", "prms_sigma"))

# Compare directly to OLS
cat("\n--- OLS ---\n")
print(coef(lm_fit))
cat("Residual SE:", sigma(lm_fit), "\n")
```



```{r}
draws <- fit$draws(format = "df")

# Age grid for predictions
age_grid <- seq(30, 80, length.out = 100)

# For each age, compute posterior mean and predictive distribution
pred_df <- purrr::map_dfr(age_grid, function(a) {
  mu_draws  <- draws$prms_alpha + draws$prms_beta * a
  # Predictive draws: add residual noise
  y_pred    <- rnorm(length(mu_draws), mu_draws, draws$prms_sigma)
  
  tibble(
    age        = a,
    # Interval for the MEAN (parameter uncertainty only)
    mu_lo      = quantile(mu_draws, 0.025),
    mu_hi      = quantile(mu_draws, 0.975),
    mu_mean    = mean(mu_draws),
    # Predictive interval (parameter uncertainty + residual noise)
    pred_lo    = quantile(y_pred, 0.025),
    pred_hi    = quantile(y_pred, 0.975)
  )
})

ggplot(pred_df, aes(x = age)) +
  # Predictive interval (wide)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = pred_lo, ymax = pred_hi),
              fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.2) +
  # Credible interval for mean (narrow)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = mu_lo, ymax = mu_hi),
              fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.5) +
  # Posterior mean line
  geom_line(aes(y = mu_mean), color = "steelblue", linewidth = 1) +
  # Observed data
  geom_point(data = data.frame(age = age, sbp = sbp),
             aes(x = age, y = sbp), alpha = 0.6) +
  # True line
  geom_abline(intercept = alpha_true, slope = beta_true,
              color = "red", linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Bayesian linear regression",
       subtitle = "Dark band = 95% CI for mean | Light band = 95% predictive interval | Red = truth",
       x = "Age (years)", y = "Systolic BP (mmHg)")
```

## Part 2

```{r}
set.seed(42)
n <- 50

# True parameters
alpha_true  <- 120   # SBP at mean age, mean BMI
beta_age    <- 0.6   # per year of age
beta_bmi    <- 1.2   # per unit of BMI
sigma_true  <- 9

age <- runif(n, 30, 80)
bmi <- rnorm(n, mean = 27, sd = 4)
sbp <- alpha_true + beta_age * age + beta_bmi * bmi +
       rnorm(n, 0, sigma_true)

# CENTRE predictors — critical step
age_c <- age - mean(age)   # age minus mean age
bmi_c <- bmi - mean(bmi)   # BMI minus mean BMI

# OLS benchmark
lm2 <- lm(sbp ~ age_c + bmi_c)
summary(lm2)

data_list2 <- list(N = n, age = age_c, bmi = bmi_c, sbp = sbp)
```

```{r}
model <- cmdstan_model("stan/normal_regression_p2.stan")
fit <- model$sample(data = data_list2,seed = 42,chains = 4,parallel_chains = 4,iter_warmup = 1000,iter_sampling = 1000)

fit$draws(variables = "prms_alpha",format = "df")
```

```{r}
fit$summary()
```

## Exp 3 Lopgistic
```{r}
set.seed(123)
n <- 40

# True parameters
alpha_true <- -7.0
beta_true  <-  0.25
# At apache=28: logit=0, p=0.50
# At apache=10: p≈0.01 (healthy, almost all survive)
# At apache=45: p≈0.99 (critically ill, almost all die)

apache <- runif(n, min = 10, max = 45)
p_true <- plogis(alpha_true + beta_true * apache)
y      <- rbinom(n, size = 1, prob = p_true)

# Inspect the separation
df <- data.frame(apache = apache, y = y,
                 group = ifelse(apache > 30, "High (>30)", "Low (≤30)"))
table(df$y, df$group)

# Frequentist benchmark — watch what happens
glm_fit <- glm(y ~ apache, family = binomial)
summary(glm_fit)

list(N = n, apache = apache, y = y)
```

```{r}
model <- cmdstan_model("stan/logistic_reg.stan")
fit_flat <- model$sample(data = list(N = n, apache = apache, y = y, sigma_alpha = 100, sigma_beta = 100),
                    seed = 42,
                    chains = 4,
                    parallel_chains = 4, 
                    iter_warmup = 1000, 
                    iter_sampling = 1000
                    )

fit_wi <- model$sample(data = list(N = n, apache = apache, y = y, sigma_alpha = 10, sigma_beta = 2.5),
                    seed = 42,
                    chains = 4,
                    parallel_chains = 4, 
                    iter_warmup = 1000, 
                    iter_sampling = 1000
                    )

fit_flat$cmdstan_diagnose()
fit_wi$cmdstan_diagnose()

fit_flat$summary(variables = c("prms_alpha","prms_beta"))
fit_wi$summary(variables = c("prms_alpha","prms_beta")) 
```


```{r}
beta_flat <- fit_flat$draws("prms_beta", format = "df") |> pull()
beta_wi   <- fit_wi$draws("prms_beta", format = "df") |> pull()

bind_rows(
  data.frame(beta = beta_flat, model = "Flat prior N(0,100²)"),
  data.frame(beta = beta_wi,   model = "Weakly informative N(0,2.5²)")
) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = beta, fill = model)) +
  geom_density(alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = beta_true, linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(-1, 50)) +
  labs(title = "Posterior for beta: flat vs. weakly informative prior",
       subtitle = "Black dashed = true beta (0.25)",
       x = "beta (log-odds per APACHE unit)", y = "Density")
```


```{r}
apache_grid <- seq(10, 45, length.out = 200)

# Get posterior draws for predicted probabilities
get_prob_ribbon <- function(fit, label) {
  draws <- fit$draws(c("prms_alpha", "prms_beta"), format = "df")
  
  purrr::map_dfr(apache_grid, function(a) {
    p_draws <- plogis(draws$prms_alpha + draws$prms_beta * a)
    tibble(
      apache = a,
      p_mean = mean(p_draws),
      p_lo   = quantile(p_draws, 0.025),
      p_hi   = quantile(p_draws, 0.975),
      model  = label
    )
  })
}

ribbon_flat <- get_prob_ribbon(fit_flat, "Flat prior")
ribbon_wi   <- get_prob_ribbon(fit_wi,   "Weakly informative")

bind_rows(ribbon_flat, ribbon_wi) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = apache, fill = model, color = model)) +
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = p_lo, ymax = p_hi), alpha = 0.2, color = NA) +
  geom_line(aes(y = p_mean), linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(data = data.frame(apache = apache, y = y),
             aes(x = apache, y = y), inherit.aes = FALSE,
             alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  # True curve
  stat_function(fun = function(a) plogis(alpha_true + beta_true * a),
                color = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  labs(title = "Predicted mortality probability by APACHE II score",
       subtitle = "Shaded = 95% credible band | Black dashed = truth",
       x = "APACHE II Score", y = "P(30-day mortality)")
```


## Experiment 5


```{r}
set.seed(42)
n <- 80

# Severity score (centred)
severity <- rnorm(n, mean = 0, sd = 1)

# True parameters
alpha_true <- 1.2    # log mean ADEs at average severity
beta_true  <- 0.5    # log-linear effect of severity
phi_true   <- 2.0    # overdispersion: Var(Y) = mu + mu²/phi

# True mean
mu_true <- exp(alpha_true + beta_true * severity)

# True DGP: Negative Binomial (NOT Poisson)
y <- rnbinom(n, mu = mu_true, size = phi_true)

cat("Observed mean:", round(mean(y), 2), "\n")
cat("Observed variance:", round(var(y), 2), "\n")
cat("Variance/Mean ratio:", round(var(y)/mean(y), 2),
    "  (Poisson predicts 1.0)\n")

# Frequentist benchmark
glm_pois <- glm(y ~ severity, family = poisson)
summary(glm_pois)

data_list <- list(N = n, y = y, severity = severity)
```


```{r}
library(cmdstanr)

model_pois <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "stan/poisson_reg.stan")
model_negBinom <- cmdstan_model(stan_file = "stan/negbinom.stan")

fit_pois <- model_pois$sample(data = data_list,
                              chains = 4, 
                              parallel_chains = 4,
                              iter_warmup = 1000,
                              iter_sampling = 2000,
                              seed = 42)

fit_negBinom <- model_negBinom$sample(data = data_list,
                                      chains = 4, 
                                      parallel_chains = 4,
                                      iter_warmup = 1000,
                                      iter_sampling = 2000,
                                      seed = 42)
```


```{r}
fit_pois$cmdstan_diagnose()
fit_negBinom$cmdstan_diagnose()
```


```{r}
fit_pois$summary(variables = c("prms_alpha","prms_beta"))
```

```{r}
fit_negBinom$summary(variables = c("prms_alpha","prms_beta","phi"))
```


```{r}
library(bayesplot)
library(posterior)

y_rep_pois <- fit_pois$draws(variables = "y_rep", format = "matrix")
y_rep_nb <- fit_pois$draws(variables = "y_rep", format = "matrix")
```



```{r}
library(ggplot2)
# Plot 1: Distribution overlay — does the model reproduce observed counts?
p1 <- ppc_dens_overlay(y, y_rep_pois[1:50,]) +
  ggtitle("Poisson: posterior predictive vs. observed")
```


```{r}
p2 <- ppc_dens_overlay(y, y_rep_nb[1:50,]) +
  ggtitle("NegBin: posterior predictive vs. observed")
```


```{r}
gridExtra::grid.arrange(p1, p2, ncol = 2)

# Plot 2: Test statistic — variance/mean ratio
# Poisson should fail here: it always predicts ratio ≈ 1
ppc_stat(y, y_rep_pois, stat = function(y) var(y)/mean(y)) +
  ggtitle("Poisson: posterior predictive variance/mean ratio") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var(y)/mean(y), color = "red")

ppc_stat(y, y_rep_nb, stat = function(y) var(y)/mean(y)) +
  ggtitle("NegBin: posterior predictive variance/mean ratio") +
  geom_vline(xintercept = var(y)/mean(y), color = "red")
```




```{r}
# Test 1: Maximum count — overdispersion creates heavy tails
ppc_stat(y, y_rep_pois, stat = "max") +
  ggtitle("Poisson: max count")

ppc_stat(y, y_rep_nb, stat = "max") +
  ggtitle("NegBin: max count")

# Test 2: Proportion of zeros
ppc_stat(y, y_rep_pois,
         stat = function(y) mean(y == 0)) +
  ggtitle("Poisson: proportion zeros")

ppc_stat(y, y_rep_nb,
         stat = function(y) mean(y == 0)) +
  ggtitle("NegBin: proportion zeros")

# Test 3: Standard deviation (more sensitive than variance/mean for this)
ppc_stat(y, y_rep_pois, stat = "sd") +
  ggtitle("Poisson: SD")

ppc_stat(y, y_rep_nb, stat = "sd") +
  ggtitle("NegBin: SD")
```


```{r}
# 1. Phi posterior — is it near 2 or near 100?
fit_negBinom$summary(variables = c("prms_alpha", "prms_beta", "phi"))

# 2. LOO comparison
library(loo)
loo_pois <- fit_pois$loo()
loo_nb   <- fit_negBinom$loo()
print(loo_pois)
print(loo_nb)
loo_compare(loo_pois, loo_nb)

# 3. Run the max/sd/zero tests above
```


## Experiment 6

```{r}
set.seed(42)
J     <- 8
n_j   <- c(15, 20, 25, 30, 50, 75, 100, 150)  # patients per site
N     <- sum(n_j)

# True parameters (unknown to analyst)
mu_true    <- 8.0    # average treatment effect (mmHg reduction)
tau_true   <- 5.0    # between-site SD (sites genuinely differ)
sigma_true <- 10.0   # within-site residual SD

# True site effects
theta_true <- rnorm(J, mean = mu_true, sd = tau_true)
cat("True site effects:\n")
print(round(theta_true, 2))

# Patient-level data
site <- rep(1:J, times = n_j)
y    <- rnorm(N, mean = theta_true[site], sd = sigma_true)

# Raw (no-pool) estimates per site
raw_means <- tapply(y, site, mean)
raw_ses   <- tapply(y, site, function(x) sd(x)/sqrt(length(x)))

cat("\nRaw site estimates (no pooling):\n")
print(data.frame(
  site    = 1:J,
  n       = n_j,
  raw_mean = round(raw_means, 2),
  raw_se   = round(raw_ses, 2),
  true_theta = round(theta_true, 2)
))

data_list <- list(N = N, J = J, site = site, y = y, n_j = n_j)
str(data_list)
```


```{r}
library(cmdstanr)
mod_np <- cmdstan_model("stan/no_pool.stan")
mod_cp <- cmdstan_model("stan/complete_pool.stan")
mod_h <- cmdstan_model("stan/hierarchical.stan")

fit_np <- mod_np$sample(data = data_list, 
                        chains = 4,
                        parallel_chains = 4,
                        seed = 42,
                        iter_warmup = 1000,
                        iter_sampling = 2000)
fit_cp <- mod_cp$sample(data = data_list, 
                        chains = 4,
                        parallel_chains = 4,
                        seed = 42,
                        iter_warmup = 1000,
                        iter_sampling = 2000)
fit_h <- mod_h$sample(data = data_list, 
                        chains = 4,
                        parallel_chains = 4,
                        seed = 42,
                        iter_warmup = 1000,
                        iter_sampling = 2000)
```


```{r}
fit_np$cmdstan_diagnose()
fit_cp$cmdstan_diagnose()
fit_h$cmdstan_diagnose()
```


```{r}
fit_h$summary(variables = c("mu", "tau", "sigma", "theta"))
```


```{r}
library(posterior)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Extract hierarchical site posteriors
h_draws    <- fit_h$draws(format = "df")
np_draws   <- fit_np$draws(format = "df")
cp_draws   <- fit_cp$draws(format = "df")

# Posterior means per site
h_means  <- colMeans(h_draws[, paste0("theta[", 1:J, "]")])
np_means <- colMeans(np_draws[, paste0("theta[", 1:J, "]")])
cp_mean  <- mean(cp_draws$mu)

# Build comparison dataframe
shrinkage_df <- data.frame(
  site        = 1:J,
  n           = n_j,
  no_pool     = np_means,
  hier        = h_means,
  complete    = cp_mean,
  truth       = theta_true
)

# Shrinkage factor: how far did partial pooling move from no-pool toward complete-pool?
shrinkage_df$B <- (shrinkage_df$no_pool - shrinkage_df$hier) /
                  (shrinkage_df$no_pool - shrinkage_df$complete)

print(round(shrinkage_df, 3))

# Plot: the shrinkage picture
ggplot(shrinkage_df, aes(x = reorder(factor(site), n))) +
  # Raw (no-pool) estimates
  geom_point(aes(y = no_pool, size = n),
             color = "red", alpha = 0.8) +
  # Hierarchical estimates
  geom_point(aes(y = hier, size = n),
             color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.8) +
  # Arrows showing shrinkage direction
  geom_segment(aes(xend = reorder(factor(site), n),
                   y = no_pool, yend = hier),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               color = "gray40") +
  # Complete pooling line
  geom_hline(yintercept = cp_mean,
             linetype = "dashed", color = "orange", linewidth = 1) +
  # True values
  geom_point(aes(y = truth), shape = 4, size = 4,
             color = "black", stroke = 2) +
  scale_size_continuous(name = "n per site", range = c(2, 6)) +
  labs(title = "Shrinkage: from no-pool (red) to hierarchical (blue)",
       subtitle = "Orange dashed = complete pool | X = true theta_j | Sites ordered by sample size",
       x = "Site (ordered by sample size)",
       y = "Estimated treatment effect (mmHg)") +
  coord_flip()
```

## Experiment 7

```{r}
set.seed(7)
J      <- 12
n_j    <- c(30, 40, 45, 50, 55, 60, 70, 80, 100, 120, 150, 200)
N      <- sum(n_j)

# True parameters
mu_alpha_true  <- -1.5   # log-odds of death at average hospital (~18% baseline)
tau_true       <- 0.8    # between-hospital SD on log-odds scale
beta_true      <- 1.2    # effect of severity score (centred)

# True hospital random intercepts
alpha_j_true <- rnorm(J, mean = mu_alpha_true, sd = tau_true)
cat("True hospital intercepts (log-odds):\n")
cat(round(alpha_j_true, 2), "\n")
cat("Implied baseline mortality rates:\n")
cat(round(plogis(alpha_j_true) * 100, 1), "%\n")

# Patient-level data
hospital  <- rep(1:J, times = n_j)
severity  <- rnorm(N, mean = 0, sd = 1)   # already centred
log_odds  <- alpha_j_true[hospital] + beta_true * severity
p_true    <- plogis(log_odds)
y         <- rbinom(N, 1, p_true)

# Raw hospital mortality rates (unadjusted)
raw_rate <- tapply(y, hospital, mean)
raw_n    <- tapply(y, hospital, length)
cat("\nRaw mortality rates by hospital:\n")
print(data.frame(
  hospital = 1:J,
  n        = n_j,
  deaths   = tapply(y, hospital, sum),
  raw_rate = round(raw_rate, 3)
))

data_list <- list(
  N        = N,
  J        = J,
  hospital = hospital,
  severity = severity,
  y        = y
)

str(data_list)
```

fit$cmdstan_diagnose()

```{r}
library(posterior)

draws <- fit$draws(format = "df")
tau_draws <- draws$tau

# Posterior distribution of ICC
icc_draws <- tau_draws^2 / (tau_draws^2 + (pi^2 / 3))

cat("ICC summary:\n")
cat(sprintf("  Mean:   %.3f\n", mean(icc_draws)))
cat(sprintf("  Median: %.3f\n", median(icc_draws)))
cat(sprintf("  90%% CI: [%.3f, %.3f]\n",
            quantile(icc_draws, 0.05),
            quantile(icc_draws, 0.95)))

# Interpretation guide
cat("\nICC interpretation:\n")
cat("  < 0.05 : negligible hospital effect\n")
cat("  0.05-0.15: modest\n")
cat("  > 0.15 : substantial — hospital matters a lot\n")
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

# Extract posterior means for each hospital's baseline mortality
p_means  <- colMeans(draws[, paste0("p_hospital[", 1:J, "]")])
p_lower  <- apply(draws[, paste0("p_hospital[", 1:J, "]")], 2, quantile, 0.025)
p_upper  <- apply(draws[, paste0("p_hospital[", 1:J, "]")], 2, quantile, 0.975)

# Population mean mortality
mu_alpha_mean <- mean(draws$mu_alpha)
pop_mean_p    <- plogis(mu_alpha_mean)

# Build funnel limits using Poisson approximation
precision_seq <- seq(10, 220, by = 5)
funnel_df <- data.frame(
  n     = precision_seq,
  upper2 = pop_mean_p + 2 * sqrt(pop_mean_p * (1 - pop_mean_p) / precision_seq),
  lower2 = pop_mean_p - 2 * sqrt(pop_mean_p * (1 - pop_mean_p) / precision_seq),
  upper3 = pop_mean_p + 3 * sqrt(pop_mean_p * (1 - pop_mean_p) / precision_seq),
  lower3 = pop_mean_p - 3 * sqrt(pop_mean_p * (1 - pop_mean_p) / precision_seq)
)

hosp_df <- data.frame(
  hospital = 1:J,
  n        = n_j,
  p_mean   = p_means,
  p_lower  = p_lower,
  p_upper  = p_upper,
  raw_rate = raw_rate
)

ggplot() +
  # Funnel limits
  geom_ribbon(data = funnel_df,
              aes(x = n, ymin = lower3, ymax = upper3),
              fill = "lightyellow", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_ribbon(data = funnel_df,
              aes(x = n, ymin = lower2, ymax = upper2),
              fill = "lightblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  # Population mean
  geom_hline(yintercept = pop_mean_p,
             color = "steelblue", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  # Hospital estimates with credible intervals
  geom_errorbar(data = hosp_df,
                aes(x = n, ymin = p_lower, ymax = p_upper),
                width = 3, color = "gray50") +
  geom_point(data = hosp_df,
             aes(x = n, y = p_mean, size = n),
             color = "steelblue", alpha = 0.9) +
  # Raw rates (unadjusted) for comparison
  geom_point(data = hosp_df,
             aes(x = n, y = raw_rate),
             shape = 4, size = 3, color = "red", stroke = 1.5) +
  geom_label(data = hosp_df,
             aes(x = n, y = p_mean, label = hospital),
             nudge_y = 0.02, size = 3) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
  labs(
    title    = "Funnel Plot: Hospital Mortality Rates",
    subtitle = "Blue dots = Bayesian (risk-adjusted) | Red X = raw rate | Bands = 2σ, 3σ",
    x        = "Hospital size (n)",
    y        = "30-day mortality rate",
    size     = "n"
  )
```

## Experiment 10

```{r}
set.seed(10)
J      <- 8
n_j    <- c(30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 100, 120)
N      <- sum(n_j)

# True parameters
mu_alpha_true  <- 1.5    # log mean readmissions at avg hospital
tau0_true      <- 0.6    # between-hospital SD in intercepts
beta_true      <- 0.4    # severity effect (log scale)
tau1_true      <- 0.2    # between-hospital SD in severity slope
phi_true       <- 3.0    # NegBin overdispersion

# True random effects
u0_true <- rnorm(J, 0, tau0_true)
u1_true <- rnorm(J, 0, tau1_true)

# Patient data
hospital <- rep(1:J, times = n_j)
severity <- rnorm(N, 0, 1)

log_mu   <- (mu_alpha_true + u0_true[hospital]) +
            (beta_true     + u1_true[hospital]) * severity
mu_true  <- exp(log_mu)
y        <- rnbinom(N, size = phi_true, mu = mu_true)

cat("Outcome summary:\n")
print(summary(y))
cat(sprintf("\nVariance/Mean ratio: %.2f  (>1 confirms overdispersion)\n",
            var(y)/mean(y)))
cat("\nHospital-level means:\n")
print(round(tapply(y, hospital, mean), 2))

data_list <- list(N=N, J=J, hospital=hospital, severity=severity, y=y)
str(data_list)
```


```{r}
# Simulate from priors alone
n_sim     <- 500
mu_a_sim  <- rnorm(n_sim, 0, 2.5)
tau_sim   <- abs(rnorm(n_sim, 0, 1))
beta_sim  <- rnorm(n_sim, 0, 1)
phi_sim   <- rexp(n_sim, 1)
u0_sim    <- rnorm(n_sim, 0, 1)

# Implied count for one patient at average severity
alpha_j   <- mu_a_sim + tau_sim * u0_sim
mu_sim    <- exp(alpha_j)
y_prior   <- rnbinom(n_sim, size = phi_sim, mu = mu_sim)

cat("Prior predictive summary:\n")
print(quantile(y_prior, c(0.01, 0.10, 0.50, 0.90, 0.99)))

# Flag if prior allows absurd counts
cat(sprintf("\nP(y > 100): %.3f\n", mean(y_prior > 100)))
cat(sprintf("P(y > 1000): %.3f\n", mean(y_prior > 1000)))

hist(pmin(y_prior, 50), breaks = 30,
     main = "Prior predictive: readmission counts (capped at 50)",
     xlab = "Count")
```


```{r}
library(cmdstanr)

mod1 <- cmdstan_model("stan/m1_pooled_nb.stan")
mod2 <- cmdstan_model("stan/m2_hier_int_nb.stan")
mod3 <- cmdstan_model("stan/m3_hier_slopes_nb.stan")

fit1 <- mod1$sample(data = c(data_list[c("N","severity","y")]),
          chains=4, parallel_chains=4,
          iter_warmup=1000, iter_sampling=2000, seed=10)

fit2 <- mod2$sample(data = data_list,
          chains=4, parallel_chains=4,
          iter_warmup=1000, iter_sampling=2000,
          adapt_delta=0.90, seed=10)

fit3 <- mod3$sample(data = data_list,
          chains=4, parallel_chains=4,
          iter_warmup=1000, iter_sampling=2000,
          adapt_delta=0.95, seed=10)
```



```{r}
# Run for all three
for (fit in list(fit1, fit2, fit3)) {
  fit$cmdstan_diagnose()
}

# Detailed check for most complex model
fit3$summary(variables = c("mu_alpha","mu_beta","tau","phi","rho")) |>
  dplyr::select(variable, mean, sd, rhat, ess_bulk, ess_tail) 

# Acceptance rates and tree depth
fit3$sampler_diagnostics() |>
  posterior::as_draws_df() |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    mean_accept  = mean(accept_stat__),
    max_treedepth = max(treedepth__),
    divergences  = sum(divergent__)
  ) 
```

```{r}
library(bayesplot)

# Extract y_rep from all models
y_rep1 <- fit1$draws("y_rep", format="matrix")
y_rep2 <- fit2$draws("y_rep", format="matrix")
y_rep3 <- fit3$draws("y_rep", format="matrix")

# PPC 1: Density overlay
p1 <- ppc_dens_overlay(y, y_rep2[1:100, ]) +
      ggtitle("M2: Density overlay")

# PPC 2: Test statistics — three quantities
ppc_stat(y, y_rep2, stat="mean")   + ggtitle("M2: Mean")
ppc_stat(y, y_rep2, stat="sd")     + ggtitle("M2: SD")
ppc_stat(y, y_rep2, stat="max")    + ggtitle("M2: Max")

# PPC 3: Zero counts (common failure mode for count models)
prop_zero <- function(x) mean(x == 0)
ppc_stat(y, y_rep2, stat=prop_zero) + ggtitle("M2: Proportion zeros")

# PPC 4: By hospital (crucial for hierarchical model)
ppc_stat_grouped(y, y_rep2[1:500, ],
                 group = hospital,
                 stat  = "mean") +
  ggtitle("M2: Mean by hospital")
```
